subject: general
question: On 1 March 2022, the National Commission for Protection of Child Rights (NCPCR) marked its _______ Foundation Day.
solution:
The correct answer is __**17th**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The National Commission for Protection of Child Rights (NCPCR) celebrates its 17th foundation day on 1 March 2022at red Fort, New Delhi.
 
• Minister for Women and Child Development Smriti Zubin Irani was the chief guest at the event.
 
• She launched the new motto of NCPCR ‘भविष्यो रक्षति रक्षित:’ ​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• NCPCR is an Indian statutory body established by the Commission for Protection of Child Rights Act, 2005.
 
• Priyank Kanoongo is the Chairman of the NCPCR.
 
• NCPCR & Border Security Force (BSF) collaborated to launch ‘SAHARA’, which is an initiative to provide psycho-social counselling & support to children of BSF jawans who made the supreme sacrifice.
